description: Header file defining the PersistentStoreImplementation class, which implements multiple store-related interfaces and manages notifications, cache, and storage operations within the WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: PersistentStoreImplementation
classes.description: Implements store interfaces, manages notifications, and handles storage operations within the plugin.

classes.name: Store2Notification
classes.description: Inner class implementing IStore2::INotification to handle value change notifications and propagate them to registered clients.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification client to receive store change events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification client from receiving store change events.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets a value in the store for a given namespace and key.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the store for a given namespace and key.

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a specific key from the store within a namespace.

methods.name: DeleteNamespace
methods.description: Deletes an entire namespace from the store.

methods.name: SetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Sets storage limit for a namespace.

methods.name: GetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Gets storage limit for a namespace.
